searches.query: seung-lab FlyConnectome programmatic access CAVE tutorial

verified_claims: Repository contains CAVE and mesh-access notebooks for FlyWire.
README identifies Codex as the bulk-download source.
limitations: Data-access tutorials only; this is not a neural or embodied simulator.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Tutorials for programmatic FlyWire access through CAVE, meshes and Codex exports.
decisions.note: Repository content checked; simulation capability is not claimed.

verified_claims: Repository contains scripts for network analyses of the FlyWire connectome.
README links the associated network and data preprints.
limitations: The published scripts describe the v630 snapshot, not current v783 data.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Network-analysis scripts and derived products for the FlyWire v630 snapshot.
decisions.note: Retained as analysis prior art; version mismatch must be explicit.

verified_claims: Repository exists and contains FAFB, maleCNS and other preparation workflows.
limitations: The repository landing page does not confirm the imported claim about a tinyurl v783 interface.
Individual notebooks and their data-version assumptions still require execution-level review.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Research repository with preparation notebooks for FAFB, MaleCNS and related connectome data.
decisions.note: Specific v783 convenience-interface claim was removed as unconfirmed.

searches.query: eonsystemspbc fly-brain Brian2CUDA PyTorch NEST GPU GeNN

verified_claims: Repository provides Brian2, Brian2CUDA, PyTorch, NEST GPU, GeNN and Brian2GeNN backends.
README documents FlyWire v783 input files and reproducible benchmark commands.
limitations: This is a connectome-constrained LIF benchmark, not an embodied nociception model.
Repository-reported benchmark results were not independently rerun in this audit.
decisions.corrected_purpose: FlyWire v783 LIF benchmark implementation across six simulation backends.
decisions.note: Suitable simulator candidate only after local reproducibility and biological-scope checks.

verified_claims: Repository and accompanying 2026 Zenodo preprint are linked from the README.
README describes a FlyWire-derived spiking network coupled to NeuroMechFly/MuJoCo.
limitations: Scientific and behavioral claims are self-reported and not independently validated here.
The README clone command points to a differently named repository.
Claims of primacy and low-cost hardware are not evidence of biological fidelity.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Experimental repository claiming FlyWire-derived spiking activity coupled to a simulated body.
decisions.note: Do not cite as a validated whole-brain emulation or nociception model.

verified_claims: README states 139,255 LIF neurons and 2.7M connections from FlyWire FAFB v783.
The implementation runs in a browser Web Worker and exposes interactive stimuli.
limitations: Behavior-emergence statements are repository claims, not peer-reviewed validation.
The connection reduction from the source connectome requires methodological review.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Interactive browser LIF visualization derived from a reduced FlyWire v783 graph.
decisions.note: Candidate for software comparison, not direct biological ground truth.

verified_claims: Repository combines MaleCNS data, a NeuroMechFly body and explicit controllers.
README documents local preparation, checksums and diagnostic/ablation controls.
limitations: The authors explicitly describe it as experimental and not physiologically validated.
Several displayed behaviors are engineered controllers and can run with the connectome disabled.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Experimental MaleCNS/FlyGym environment with explicit hybrid behavioral controllers.
decisions.note: Useful integration scaffold; engineered behavior must not be attributed to the connectome.

verified_claims: Repository implements resident and streamed sparse-graph runtimes for MaleCNS data.
README labels measured, estimated and not-tested evidence separately.
limitations: No biological calibration or scientific fidelity claim is made.
Reported timings are host-specific infrastructure measurements.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Infrastructure benchmark for resident and streamed execution of a MaleCNS-derived sparse graph.
decisions.note: Retain for runtime engineering only, not as neuroscience validation.

searches.query: chaobrain fitting Drosophila whole brain spiking model

verified_claims: Repository implements a two-stage SNN plus RNN activity-fitting workflow.
README identifies FlyWire 630/783 and Drosophila neural recordings as inputs.
README links the associated Nature Communications article DOI 10.1038/s41467-026-68453-w.
limitations: The local workflow was not executed in this audit.
Activity fitting does not establish nociception, pain or embodied behavior validity.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Two-stage SNN/RNN workflow for fitting region-level Drosophila neural dynamics.
decisions.note: Promising simulation candidate subject to local reproduction and task-specific validation.

searches.query: Jessica Jones Circuit Reconstruction Drosophila nociception

verified_claims: Author project page describes circuit reconstruction, optogenetics and behavior analysis for adult-fly nociception.
The page links preprint DOI 10.1101/2025.10.28.684868 and its analysis-code repository.
limitations: The imported md-neuron to two-pathway summary was not verified from the project page alone.
The linked work is a preprint and must not be treated as settled evidence of subjective pain.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Primary project page and preprint/code links for adult Drosophila nociceptive circuit reconstruction.
decisions.note: Use only for nociceptive pathways and defensive behavior, not subjective pain.

verified_claims: Official project provides MaleCNS v1.0 annotations, connectivity, skeletons and neuPrint access.
Official project reports 166,700 neurons across brain and ventral nerve cord.
Dataset is licensed CC BY.
limitations: MaleCNS and female FAFB/FlyWire are different specimens and scopes.
The original 25.5M-connections wording was removed because the official download exposes multiple count definitions.
decisions.corrected_purpose: Official MaleCNS v1.0 download and programmatic-access page for the complete male CNS connectome.
decisions.note: Use explicit release, filtering and count definitions in every derived dataset.
